findings.summary: Recovery can strand a graceful stop in stopping with no in-flight call left to drain. If interruption occurs after graceful stop records stopping but before the in-flight Goal call persists its Stop List, restore requeues the request and clears current_call while retaining stopping. next_goal_call then refuses admission, and no completion remains to transition the goal to stopped. Reconcile this interrupted-drain state explicitly and cover it with an offline reconstruction test; the current behavior does not satisfy the recoverable stop lifecycle required by behaviors 5 and 7.

The supplied input_commit and subject_commit are the same full RC identity.
